privacyModel: All channels are public organizational views over the existing shared Ferret Frenzy chat. No faction/private channel is created.

channels.label: burrow
channels.purpose: Public lobby coordination before the deal, then Morning Business and ordinary discussion

channels.label: evidence
channels.purpose: Wake hours, Treat State, co-wakers, and mechanically checkable observations

channels.label: claims
channels.purpose: Role claims, counterclaims, and card-movement explanations

channels.label: paw-point
channels.purpose: Vote coordination and final public arguments; actual votes remain private

channels.label: narrator
channels.purpose: Narrator announcements and host narrator messages

turnFloor.influence: Zoom-style mute/unmute state plus raise-hand queue, translated into text-chat turn control
turnFloor.enforcementNote: The current frontend disables the ordinary message composer for players without the floor. The existing backend chat API has no turn-floor permission check, so this is a shared client-side meeting control, not an anti-cheat boundary.
